summary: Iteration 7: tested (1) Add Stock transparent upload -> ivory background, (2) Edit Rack Auto cutout (Gemini + green keying), (3) Edit Rack unsaved-changes warning, plus regressions. Backend: 9/9 new tests pass (test_upload_autocutout.py) + 18/18 test_rack_admin.py regression. Frontend: every requested flow passed. Used exactly 2 AI calls (1 API, 1 UI), both on olive-lotus-square-neck-tunic, and both returned a clean clothes-only RGBA cutout. Restored the rack to the exact original 10 items/paths via PUT, which was verified equal. The draft test product was created and then deleted (0 left).

minor.issue: The despill loop (lines 155-159) clamps green on EVERY opaque pixel where g > max(r,b)+25, not only on edge or spill pixels. A truly green garment (emerald or bottle-green kurta) would be turned grey or olive. Olive passed because its g-max(r,b) is small. Limit despill to pixels next to keyed-out pixels, or to low-alpha fringe pixels.

The check `img.format not in (None,) and w*h > 40MP` runs after convert(), when format is always None, so the 40MP limit never applies (dead code). Check size before converting, as routes_rack.upload_rack_image does.
Every auto cutout writes a media record and object even when the rack is never saved, so unused images pile up. Consider cleanup or tagging them as unsaved drafts.

ui_bugs.issue: Save is disabled whenever the page is not dirty, even when the rack is NOT configured (data.configured=false). The page text says 'saving here will fix the selection', but the admin cannot save the default list without making a dummy change first. Fix: disabled={saving || (data.configured && !dirty)}

issues: Only <a href> clicks and beforeunload are guarded. Browser Back/Forward (popstate) and the 'Sign out' button leave without a prompt. Optional: use a react-router blocker.

action_items: Limit green despill in _key_out_green to fringe pixels so green garments keep their colour
Allow Save when the rack is unconfigured even if not dirty (matches the spec: disabled only when configured and not dirty)
Move the 40MP dimension check in upload_image before convert() (it is currently dead code)
Optional: guard browser back (popstate) and Sign out when there are unsaved changes; clean up unsaved auto-cutout media
